scripts.test: pnpm --dir packages/terset test && pnpm test:py && vitest run --maxWorkers=2 && pnpm check:docs
scripts.build: pnpm --dir packages/terset build && pnpm --dir apps/site build
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && pnpm --dir apps/site run deploy
scripts.generate: pnpm --dir apps/site run generate && pnpm --dir apps/site run docs
scripts.gate: pnpm generate && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm deploy:check
